excluded_features.Tpot (K): Potential temperature is derived from temperature and pressure.
excluded_features.Tdew (degC): Dew point together with humidity can encode temperature.
excluded_features.VPmax (mbar): Saturation vapor pressure is a function of temperature.
excluded_features.VPact (mbar): Vapor pressure combined with humidity can encode temperature.
excluded_features.VPdef (mbar): Vapor pressure deficit contains temperature-dependent information.
excluded_features.sh (g/kg): Specific humidity combines with other weather variables to recover temperature.
excluded_features.H2OC (mmol/mol): Water concentration may indirectly recover temperature with other inputs.
excluded_features.rho (g/m**3): Air density is linked algebraically to pressure and temperature.
